lead.headline: Furia Regia bank 41.5 on Thursday; Pickens waits on Saturday
lead.deck: Win probability drops to 38%. Loveland, 12 targets and a hurt teammate, is Tuesday's question.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Furia Regia's backs both beat their numbers on Thursday — D'Andre Swift 19.0, Rhamondre Stevenson 22.5 — and ESPN now has you at 38%, 122.8 against 145.2. George Pickens is still limited with the shoulder and plays Monday night; if Saturday's Cowboys report lists him doubtful or out, Xavier Worthy goes into the flex before Sunday 18:20. Matthew Golden (shoulder) has LaFleur's 'no concern', Josh Jacobs took handoffs Thursday, and Friday's report decides whether he replaces Ollie Gordon before 11:00 Sunday. On the wire, Colston Loveland drew 12 targets as Cole Kmet was carted off — a Tuesday claim if the diagnosis is serious.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to fire today — Pickens waits for Saturday, Jacobs for Friday's report
doFirst.deck: Worthy is the fallback for both Golden and Pickens; Jacobs over Gordon only on a clear status by Sunday 10:30.
doFirst.note: No claims today: priority never resets, and Loveland's claim cannot process before Wednesday, so it waits for Kmet's diagnosis and Tuesday's run. Pickens (shoulder, Monday night): if Saturday's report lists him doubtful or out, swap Worthy into the flex before Sun 18:20. Hold the Jets D/ST (0.3 over the Titans) and Gay (0.6 under Butker).
doFirst.empty: Nothing to fire this Friday morning — Green Bay's designations come this afternoon, Dallas's on Saturday.
